title: Veloce Query Fabric
description: Distributed telemetry aggregator and sharded PostgreSQL cluster fabric with live partition rebalancing. Delivers instantaneous metric ingest for industrial IoT sensors with strict guarantees.
abstract: Veloce Architecture Document V2.1 — Citus/Pgpool partition strategies, Rust memory pools, and zero-copy socket IO.

title: AetherLog Realtime Analytics
description: Astro SSR combined with a Server-Sent Events streaming pipeline. Zero initial client-side JavaScript baseline while streaming 100,000 live event logs to an edge dashboard.
abstract: AetherLog Architecture — HTTP/2 SSE streaming engine, zero-hydration Islands fallback, and sub-10ms TTFB edge caching.

title: Hyperion Design System Engine

abstract: Hyperion Architecture — AST token graph resolution, CSS variable emission trees, and WebAssembly memory sharing.

title: Solis Distributed Mesh v2
description: Sub-millisecond peer-to-peer telemetry gossip protocol over WebRTC data channels with state-based conflict resolution.
abstract: Solis Distributed Mesh Architecture V2 — Multi-peer state reconciliation using CRDTs over WebRTC data channels.
